The issue is linked to https://github.com/Textualize/rich/issues/3838.

Looking at the file list, `rich/text.py` and `rich/console.py` seem like good places to start. `rich/_wrap.py` might also be relevant.

Let's start by trying to reproduce the issue. I'll create a small script that uses soft wrap and a background style.

Wait, I don't have the issue description from GitHub, only the title "fix background style with soft wrap".
Usually, soft wrap means that the text is wrapped to the next line without inserting a hard newline character.

If I have a string with a background color and it wraps, the background color should ideally continue on the next line until the end of the styled text.
